Grace / Monica — noted. Quick technical clarifications for Catalyst so we can map the controls correctly:

1) KMS topology: Redwood uses a hybrid model — customer-controlled keys for Private deployments (bring-your-own KMS/HSM) and Redwood-managed KMS with CMKs in our cloud regions for Hosted customers. I'll attach a simplified KMS diagram and call out rotation cadence.

2) Telemetry & logs: Rolling telemetry retention varies by plan — default is 90 days indexing in our observability store; for Dedicated/Private we can configure longer retention and provide export bundles for audits.

3) Isolation & multi-tenant: For Hosted customers we use strict namespace isolation, token-level ACLs, and request-level smart routing. For Dedicated/Private we map controls to physically isolated GPU pools or VPCs.

Owners & deliverables (for internal tracking):
- Karthik: redwood-kms-diagram.png, KMS rotation excerpt, telemetry retention clause (deliver by Thu EOD)
- Monica: SIG workbook first pass, artifact links, and legal/contract redline notes (deliver by next Tue)
- Ben: coordinate NDA and upload signed copy to Catalyst's portal

I'll prepare the diagram and a short narrative so Monica can reference artifacts inline in the workbook.

—Karthik
